packageRules.description: Pin typescript below 6.1.0 until @typescript-eslint supports the new major (TS 7 dropped APIs such as ts.Extension and the downlevelIteration compiler option that typescript-eslint and this repo's tsconfig currently rely on).
Hold the GitHub runner at ubuntu 24.04 until Playwright supports Ubuntu 26.04 (install-deps falls back to 24.04 packages, so WebKit fails with missing libicu*.so.74 and libxml2.so.2).
